verdict_reason: Species swaps correctly track the MDM stub data (ostriches non-exempt, 'Equus cabalus' exempt), but the species literals are duplicated across FIT specs instead of living in the journey helper.

todos.issue: The CPH tests pass species Latin names as bare literals ('Struthio' at 124, 'Equus cabalus' at 139) that other FIT specs already name locally (EQUUS_CABALUS and STRUTHIO in commodities/fit/identification.fit.spec.js; 'Equus cabalus' again in additional-details.fit.spec.js); the stub-data spelling lives in several specs
todos.fix: Must: each stub species a FIT spec drives by name is declared once in the set's journey helper and imported by every spec. One way: export named species constants (for example OSTRICH = 'Struthio', HORSE = 'Equus cabalus') from fit/live-animals-journey.js beside the 'Felis catus' default of unlockSections, and replace the local copies

todos.issue: Comment 'The selector pins placement: the section name is the element directly above the role heading...' explains why the selector was chosen: rationale in code
todos.fix: Must: no rationale comment in the test. One way: delete the comment, or move the reason to the set's docs; a named locator such as captionDirectlyAboveHeading can carry the intent
